title: KCSAN: data-race in macsec_handle_frame / macsec_handle_frame (3)
two_threads_summary: KCSAN-reported two-context race. KCSAN: data-race in macsec_handle_frame / macsec_handle_frame (3)
audit_notes: Subject: 'macsec: use DEV_STATS_INC()'. Pre-classifier PROBABLY_GOOD (real synchronization primitives on + lines).
fix_commit_message:
32d0a49d36a2a306c2e47fe5659361e424f0ed3f
macsec: use DEV_STATS_INC()

syzbot/KCSAN reported data-races in macsec whenever dev->stats fields
are updated.

It appears all of these updates can happen from multiple cpus.

Adopt SMP safe DEV_STATS_INC() to update dev->stats fields.

Fixes: c09440f7dcb3 ("macsec: introduce IEEE 802.1AE driver")
